description: Add stored procedures and views for catalog operations
author: Onesimus

views.name: vw_job_summary
views.description: Zusammenfassung aller Jobs mit Client- und Pool-Namen
views.query: SELECT j.jobid, j.job, j.name AS jobname, j.type, j.level, j.jobstatus, j.schedtime, j.starttime, j.endtime, j.jobfiles, j.jobbytes, j.joberrors, j.volsessionid, j.volsessiontime, c.name AS clientname, p.name AS poolname FROM job j LEFT JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid LEFT JOIN pool p ON j.poolid = p.poolid

views.name: vw_volume_status
views.query: SELECT m.mediaid, m.volumename, m.volstatus, m.volbytes, m.voljobs, m.volfiles, m.volmounts, m.volerrors, m.maxvolbytes, m.mediatype, m.slot, p.name AS poolname, CASE WHEN m.maxvolbytes > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * m.volbytes / m.maxvolbytes, 1) ELSE 0 END AS pct_full FROM media m LEFT JOIN pool p ON m.poolid = p.poolid

views.name: vw_last_backup_per_client
views.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.name) c.name AS clientname, j.jobid, j.name AS jobname, j.level, j.starttime, j.endtime, j.jobfiles, j.jobbytes FROM job j JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid WHERE j.type = 'B' AND j.jobstatus = 'T' ORDER BY c.name, j.starttime DESC

views.name: vw_file_list
views.description: Dateiliste mit Pfaden (ersetzt den fehleranfaelligen filename-Join)
views.query: SELECT f.fileid, f.jobid, p.path || f.name AS filepath, f.fileindex, f.markid FROM file f JOIN path p ON f.pathid = p.pathid

functions.name: sp_create_job_record
functions.description: Erstelle einen neuen Job-Record und gib die JobId zurueck
functions.params: p_job text, p_name text, p_type char(1), p_level char(1), p_client text, p_pool text, p_fileset text, p_sched_time bigint

functions.name: sp_update_job_end
functions.description: Update Job-End: Status, Files, Bytes, Errors, VolSession
functions.params: p_job_id integer, p_status char(1), p_end_time bigint, p_files bigint, p_bytes bigint, p_errors integer, p_vol_session_id integer, p_vol_session_time integer
functions.body:
BEGIN
  UPDATE job SET
    jobstatus = p_status,
    endtime = to_timestamp(p_end_time::float8),
    realendtime = to_timestamp(p_end_time::float8),
    jobfiles = p_files,
    jobbytes = p_bytes,
    joberrors = p_errors,
    volsessionid = p_vol_session_id,
    volsessiontime = p_vol_session_time
  WHERE jobid = p_job_id;
END;

functions.name: fn_find_appendable_volume
functions.description: Finde ein beschreibbares Volume in einem Pool
functions.body: SELECT m.volumename FROM media m JOIN pool p ON m.poolid = p.poolid WHERE p.name = p_pool_name AND m.volstatus = 'Append' ORDER BY m.mediaid LIMIT 1;

functions.name: fn_find_latest_backup
functions.description: Finde den letzten erfolgreichen Backup-Job fuer einen Client
functions.body: SELECT j.jobid FROM job j JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid WHERE c.name = p_client_name AND j.type = 'B' AND j.jobstatus = 'T' ORDER BY j.jobid DESC LIMIT 1;

functions.name: sp_create_jobmedia
functions.description: Erstelle einen JobMedia-Record und update Media EndFile/EndBlock. Flaschenhals bei grossen Backups — SP vermeidet Round-Trips, spaeter durch Rust Batch-Insert ersetzbar.
functions.params: p_job_id integer, p_media_id integer, p_first_index integer, p_last_index integer, p_start_file integer, p_end_file integer, p_start_block bigint, p_end_block bigint, p_copy integer, p_strip integer, p_job_bytes bigint

functions.name: fn_since_utime
functions.description: Berechne since_utime fuer Incremental/Differential Backup. Incremental: letzter erfolgreicher Backup (F/I/D). Differential: letzter erfolgreicher Full (F).
functions.body: SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM j.starttime)::bigint, 0) AS since_utime, j.job AS prev_job FROM job j JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid WHERE c.name = p_client_name AND j.type = 'B' AND j.jobstatus = 'T' AND (CASE WHEN p_level = 'D' THEN j.level = 'F' ELSE j.level IN ('F','I','D') END) ORDER BY j.starttime DESC LIMIT 1;
